visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The First Item Is Never Compared
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The array 12, 11, 13, 5, 6 should be sorted to [5,6,11,12,13], but the program prints [12,5,6,11,13].

solution.explanation: Index 0 is a valid item that may also have to move. The condition must allow j to reach 0 (j >= 0). With j > 0 the first item is never compared or shifted.
